annotations.message: Node.js 20 is deprecated. The following actions target Node.js 20 but are being forced to run on Node.js 24: actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4. For more information see: https://github.blog/changelog/2025-09-19-deprecation-of-node-20-on-github-actions-runners/
"The ubuntu-latest label will migrate to Ubuntu 26 beginning October 19, 2026. For more information, see https://github.com/actions/runner-images/issues/14748"

structuredContent.providerGuidance: GitHub guidance for this response only: use checkRunId for output and annotations, runId from a GitHub Actions /runs/<id> link to list jobs, or jobId from a /jobs/<id> link for logs. page paginates checks, jobs or annotations. Keep the supplied account and returned headRevision on follow-up reads. Third-party CI exposes only the output reported to GitHub.
